अनन्या शर्मा
Ananya Sharma
Software Engineer · Pune, India
ananya.sharma.dev@example.com · +91 90000 67890 · github.com/ananyasharma

SUMMARY
Software engineer with 5.3 years of experience building ordering and loyalty platforms for food and beverage brands. I
care about software that works in every script and every language our customers read.

EXPERIENCE

Café Délice — Senior Engineer, "Orders & Loyalty" Platform                             Pune · Jun 2023 – Present
French-style café chain with 60 outlets across Pune, Mumbai and Bengaluru; app and web ordering.
- Rebuilt the in-app ordering flow in React Native; weekly orders through the app rose 18% in the first quarter after
  launch.
- Added Devanagari, Tamil and Kannada menu names with locale-aware sorting and search (ICU collation) for 100% of the
  menu in 3 languages.
- Designed the "Délice Points" loyalty ledger; point-expiry bugs dropped from 14 a month to 1.
- Migrated order history to PostgreSQL with no lost orders across 1.2 million records.

Naïve Labs — Software Engineer                                                      Mumbai · Jul 2021 – May 2023
- Built a multilingual SMS reminder service (Hindi, Marathi, English) used by 3 clinic chains; delivery rate improved
  from 91% to 98%.
- Wrote the text-normalisation library that handles Unicode combining marks in customer names, removing about 1,100
  duplicate records.

PROJECTS
- Crème — Recipe-scaling calculator for bakers; handles fractions such as ½ and ¾ and metric/imperial conversion.
  TypeScript. github.com/ananyasharma/creme-scaler
- bhasha-sort — Unicode-aware collation for Indian-language menus (Devanagari, Tamil, Kannada) with test cases for
  conjuncts such as क्ष and ज्ञ. Python. github.com/ananyasharma/bhasha-sort

EDUCATION
B.E. Computer Engineering — Savitribai Phule Pune University                                         2017 – 2021

SKILLS
Languages: TypeScript, Python, SQL
Mobile and web: React Native, React
Data: PostgreSQL
Internationalisation: Unicode, ICU, CLDR, locale-aware sorting, text normalisation
Tooling: GitHub Actions, Jest, pytest

# GitHub: Ananya Sharma (@ananyasharma)

## Profile
- Name: Ananya Sharma
- Account type: User
- Bio: Building tasty software 🥐☕ | मराठी · हिन्दी · English 🚀
- Company: Café Délice
- Location: Pune, India 🇮🇳
- Followers: 96, following: 74
- On GitHub since 2019-02-03 (about 7 years)

## Totals
- Public repositories: 7
- Original repos: 6, forks: 1
- Stars across original repos: 52
- Languages by number of original repos: TypeScript (3), Python (2), Shell (1)
- Repos with a description: 6/6, with topics: 4, with a live homepage link: 1
- Engineering practice (checked 7 repos): tests in 4, CI in 4, Docker in 1

## Profile README (the repo named after the user)
> नमस्ते! I write software that reads every script: ক, க, ಕ, क.
> Currently: ordering + loyalty at Café Délice 🥐. Always testing with names like "Zoë", "Ñandú" and "अनन्या".

## Top repositories (3, ranked by stars, recency and substance)

### 1. bhasha-sort
- Description: Unicode-aware collation for Indian-language menus: Devanagari, Tamil and Kannada, including conjunct consonants.
- Language: Python, stars: 31, forks: 4, license: MIT
- Topics: unicode, collation, devanagari, i18n
- Last push: 2026-09-02 (1 month ago), created 2024-08-14, size 410 KB
- Detected: tests yes (44 test files), CI yes (GitHub Actions), Docker no, docs yes, manifests: pyproject.toml
- README excerpt:
> # bhasha-sort
> Sort and search menu items the way a reader of the script expects. Handles conjuncts (क्ष, ज्ञ), nukta variants and mixed-script
> strings such as "Café फ़िल्टर कॉफ़ी". Test cases are written as table-driven fixtures.

### 2. creme-scaler
- Description: Recipe-scaling calculator for bakers (Crème): fractions like ½ and ¾, metric and imperial.

- Description: Normalise personal names for matching: NFC/NFKC, combining marks and stray whitespace.

TypeScript, Python, Unicode, ICU, GitHub Actions
